blocks.text: The largest market on Earth ($6 Trillion/Day). Trading the health of nations.
You cannot just "Buy Dollar". You must exchange it for something else.

This means: 1 Dollar = 83.50 Rupees.
- If you think India will do well ➔ You BUY INR (Sell USD).
- If you think USA will raise rates ➔ You BUY USD (Sell INR).
blocks.title: USD / INR = 83.50

blocks.text: Currencies move very slowly. A 1% move is huge. To make money, traders use Leverage.
With ₹1,000, you can control ₹1,00,000 worth of Dollars.
⚠️ Danger: A 1% move against you wipes out your entire capital instantly.
Forex is not about charts. It is about Central Banks.

items: Interest Rates: Higher rates attract money. If US Fed raises rates, USD goes UP.
Inflation: High inflation destroys currency value.
Geopolitics: War scares investors. They run to safe havens (USD, CHF).

blocks.text:
The Strategy: Borrow money in a country with LOW interest rates (e.g., Japan, 0%). Invest that money in a country with HIGH interest rates (e.g., USA, 5%).
Profit: You pocket the 5% difference for free. This is how hedge funds make billions (until the currency crashes).
